settings.language.title: Language

settings.theme.title: Theme
settings.theme.description: Dark, light, or as the system has it (it changes with the system's own).

settings.accent.saveFailed: Could not save the accent color: {error}
settings.folderPreviews.title: Previews on folders
settings.folderPreviews.description: A folder's icon shows up to four of its pictures, videos or documents, as Dolphin does.
settings.folderPreviews.keywords: thumbnails previews folder icon dolphin pictures miniaturas prévias pasta ícone fotos
settings.folderPreviewsDrive.title: Previews on the drive's folders
settings.folderPreviewsDrive.description: Pictures only, decoded in the app (nothing written to disk), one folder at a time. Off, the drive's folders keep a plain icon.
settings.folderPreviewsDrive.keywords: thumbnails previews folder drive git-drive privacy miniaturas prévias pasta privacidade
settings.photoMap.title: Map of where a photo was taken
settings.photoMap.description: In a photo's Properties, a map of its location. The map comes from OpenStreetMap, whose servers see the area shown; off, only the coordinates.
settings.photoMap.keywords: gps location privacy openstreetmap mapa localização privacidade
settings.previewLimitPanel.title: Largest file the preview panel renders
settings.previewLimitPanel.description: Markdown rendered, JSON formatted and 3D models drawn up to this size; larger ones show as text, or with their details.
settings.previewLimitQuickLook.title: Largest file Quick Look renders
settings.previewLimitQuickLook.descripti: The same for Quick Look (Space), opened on purpose, so it can take larger files.
settings.previewLimit.keywords: preview quick look size limit markdown json 3d stl 3mf obj model pré-visualização tamanho limite modelo
settings.statusBar.title: Status bar
settings.statusBar.description: The bar under each folder: how many items, the icon size, the terminal button.

settings.preview.title: Preview panel
